top_comments.text: Man, the Myths 5 pull proved it. You're one government directive away from losing your stack with zero contractual remedy. Open weights on your own infra is the only real hedge.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: That whole incident made it obvious how fragile hosted setups are — one policy change and you’re locked out with nothing you can do about it. Self-hosting open models is starting to feel less like a preference and more like insurance. Have you started migrating anything important over, or are you still testing the waters?
